description: Editorial registry of spoken memory names per Bible story (PAL Memory Doctrine, Slice 2c.1). Each entry pairs a bibleStoryKey with the exact phrase PAL should speak when referring to that story in a memory line — e.g. 'Yesterday you sat with {displayName}.' OPT-IN: stories without an entry will not produce a memory line; the engine's silence floor catches them. NEVER inferred from story titles; every choice is editorial. Adam authors. The clipId is the audio-layer identifier (eventually maps to one MP3 per PAL voice); decoupled from displayName so a future re-wording can reuse the existing render. See docs/PAL_MEMORY_DOCTRINE.md.

entries.notes: Just the character. The lions' den is implicit in the listening context.

Both names — the contest is the story; neither character makes sense alone.
